sentences.text: IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROVISIONS OF THE RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITION, REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT, 2013, ETC.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THROUGH PHYSICAL HEARING/VIDEO CONFERENCING THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.I.ARUN  ORAL ORDER 1.

The case of the petitioner is that the land belonging to him which is the subject matter of the writ petition has been illegally utilized by the respondent - Bangalore Development Authority (BDA) for formation of a road.
2. Learned counsel appearing for respondents disputes the said statement made by the petitioner.

However, he fairly submits that a survey will be conducted and if it is found that the land of the petitioner has indeed been utilized for formation of the road without following due process, the petitioner will be compensated in accordance NC: 2024:KHC:36874 with law.
The petitioner is agreeable for the same.

Hence, the following:
ORDER i. Respondent No.2 is directed to consider the representation of the petitioner within a period of 12 weeks from today by conducting necessary survey.

If it is found that the land of the petitioner has indeed been utilized without following due process, compensation will be paid to the petitioner for utilization of his property for formation of the road taking into consideration the value of the land as on the date of conducting the survey.
ii. The writ petition is disposed of accordingly.
